founders.name: Dr. Rana Mustafa
paragraphs: After years of living outside Egypt, we came back and enrolled our children in local nurseries. That is when we started seeing the gaps for ourselves.
Parents had little visibility into their child’s day, while nursery teams were managing updates, photos, attendance, and communication across WhatsApp groups and manual processes.
We realised the problem was not the care. It was the way everything was connected.

founders.name: Mr. Mohammed
paragraphs: We started sitting down with nursery owners and listening to what was happening behind the scenes. We heard the same challenges again and again, and began building Yawmy Care around them.
Today, Yawmy brings the nursery, teachers, and parents into one organised space, making it easier to manage the day and stay connected.
And one thing we will never do: charge parents to stay connected to their children.
